findings.title: A sensitive benefit's corrective case, transition decision and performance-area link stay listed and readable, by item, to a user who gets 404 on the benefit itself
findings.reproduction: Candidate aa219bd2 (source 95f981917), disposable clone and PostgreSQL 16.15, probe apps/api/test/integration/zz-domain/dom-r3-sensitive-registers.test.ts (copy in probes/dom-r3-sensitive-registers.test.ts.txt). Run: QA_PG_PORT=29500 tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project integration <probe>. Setup, all SYNTHETIC: seedClosureWorld; BO creates a benefit; BO drafts a transition decision for it (TD-01); TO creates a performance area and BO links the benefit; a worker-style benefit_variance corrective case names the benefit (title 'Synthetic CONFIDENTIAL tariff uplift variance', a recovery plan, consecutive_off_track 2); the TO marks the benefit sensitive (PUT .../records/benefit/{id}/sensitivity). Then, as TL (not a named party) and as AUD, read: GET /benefits/{id}; GET /corrective-actions and /corrective-actions/{caseId}; GET /transition-decisions and /transition-decisions/{id}; GET /performance-areas/{areaId}/links.
findings.expected: ADR-0051 §2 and its 2026-11-04 amendment: a sensitive record the principal is not admitted to is absent from lists. A route whose path names a restricted child answers 404. The rows that carry its values are the types in SENSITIVE_CHILD_SOURCES, and corrective_case, transition_decision and performance_area_link are listed there (sensitive-reach.ts lines 110-112, benefitChild). REQ-S10-002 acceptance: 'a sensitive benefit is hidden from a workstream member without the grant'. M0188: 'Enforce permissions on the server for records, files, APIs, exports, search'. TL and AUD should therefore not find the case, the decision or the link in the lists (or should receive them without the benefit), and the item routes should answer 404, as already happens for the benefit's measurements, plan values, scenario values, overlaps and finance validations. The REQ-S10-002 register row should describe the repaired state. Its AN-Z1 residual (1) about scenarios is also stale since BE-Z3.
findings.actual: TL and AUD get 404 on GET /benefits/{id} (the control). Yet both receive 200 with the rows in every list and item route (probe-sensitive-registers.log, summary {caseInList:true, decisionInList:true, linkInList:true, caseItem:200, decisionItem:200} for both). The corrective case returns benefitId, the benefit's current lifecycle step ('identify', read from the benefit row by presentCases), sourceKind 'benefit_variance', the off-track count, the title and the recovery plan. That discloses that this benefit exists and is off track, and what the recovery is. The transition decision returns benefitId, the rationale, expectedRealizationEnd, the residual owner and the status. The area link returns benefitId. The audit routes already redact these rows (BE-Y1), and the export check refuses them (restrictedAmong over assembly sources). Only the register routes themselves (raid/corrective-cases.ts list, item and signals; sustainment/transition-decisions.ts list and item; sustainment/performance-areas.ts links) apply neither withoutRestricted nor a SENSITIVE_REACH_PARAMS guard (correctiveCaseId and transitionDecisionId are not in the map). The register discloses this as a 'domain question' (REQ-S10-002 residual 2; BE-Z3 handback 'What remains'), and D-210 left it undecided. I judge it a defect, because the shipped ADR rule and the code's own child-source map already classify these rows as carrying the benefit's values.

history.note: Raised in DG6 round 3 by domain-reviewer, answering the D-210 open question 1. High and mandatory (access control). Suggested repair: apply withoutRestricted to the corrective-case, transition-decision and area-link lists (and the case's signals and actions), and add correctiveCaseId and transitionDecisionId (and the link item, if it has one) to SENSITIVE_REACH_PARAMS. Add a test with the negative case (TL, AUD) and the positive case (TO, owner, grantee). Then update the REQ-S10-002 register row.

findings.title: The operational exception page shows the server's English 'Last error' sentence on the Arabic screen, although the Arabic text for the same code is in the catalogue
findings.reproduction: Candidate aa219bd2 (source 95f981917), disposable clone, apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh. Run e2e/a17-failing-connector-exception.spec.ts in chromium-ar (passes). Open the screenshot screenshots/ar/a17-exception-data-owner.png: Administration > Operations > one 'connector unreachable' exception. Code: apps/web/src/pages/admin/operations/OperationsPages.tsx renders <bdi>{x.lastErrorMessage}</bdi> under adminP6.operations.lastError. The API fills that field with the English adapter text from apps/api/src/modules/integrations/adapters/port.ts ('connector.source_unavailable': 'The source system did not respond.').
findings.expected: Arabic RTL and English LTR for every user-facing string (CLAUDE.md; REQ-S15-007). ADR-0007 says the problem title/detail are English diagnostics and never the user-facing message. The page should show the localized text of lastErrorCode. apps/web/src/i18n/ar/integrations.json already has actionable.connector__source_unavailable.why = 'لم يستجب نظام المصدر.', and the Connectors page uses that catalogue. The raw message could stay as a secondary diagnostic only.
findings.actual: On the Arabic exception page every label is Arabic and the error code is shown, but the 'آخر خطأ' value reads 'The source system did not respond.' in English. The English screen is correct. The page shows no wrong value and no infrastructure term, so this is cosmetic. It has no effect on state, RAG or approvals.

history.note: Raised in DG6 round 3 by domain-reviewer. Low, not blocking on its own. Suggested repair: render the lastErrorCode's catalogue text (integrations actionable.<code>.why, the same lookup the Connectors page uses) and fall back to the raw message only when no text exists.

findings.title: Saving a connector with a secret reference IT has not bound (D-209) shows 'Check the highlighted fields' with no field highlighted and never says the reference is not bound
findings.reproduction: Candidate aa219bd2 (source 95f981917), disposable clone, production-initialized stack apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh (its SECRET_BINDINGS_FILE binds only the A17 webhook secret). Probe e2e/zz-domain/dom-r3-screens.spec.ts (copy in probes/dom-r3-screens.spec.ts.txt), en and ar. Steps: as dev.admin, create a test_adapter connector through the API. In the UI, open Administration > Integrations > the connector > Edit. Add a credential reference (purpose 'api', provider 'env', secret name 'MTH_SECRET_DOMAIN_R3_NOT_BOUND'), give a reason and press Save.
findings.expected: D-209 / ADR-0052 §5 amendment: the API answers 400 validation with the field error validation.secret_ref_not_bound at the reference ('Name a secret IT bound to this setting...'). REQ-S15-011: the error state is handled explicitly. The form should mark the credential row it names (pointer /config/credentialRefs/api) and say, in the user's language, that IT has not bound this secret to this setting, so the administrator knows what to ask IT for. ADR-0052 itself notes that 'if a form shows them as text, the web owner adds the Arabic'.
findings.actual: The API answers correctly: PUT -> 400, code validation, errors [{pointer:'/config/credentialRefs/api', code:'validation.secret_ref_not_bound'}]. The form then shows only the generic banner 'Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.' / 'بعض القيم غير صالحة. راجع الحقول المميّزة.', and 0 fields are marked invalid (the probe counts .field--invalid = 0). ConnectorFormPage maps server field errors to no field: the credential row's error slot is keyed credential.<i> for client checks only. The web catalogue has no text for validation.secret_ref_not_bound or validation.secret_ref_host_not_bound. The administrator is told to check highlighted fields that do not exist, and is never told the cause. The refusal itself and the audit event are correct. The effect is bounded to the administrator's connector form (the same pattern likely applies to the other SecretRef settings: webhooks, SMTP, storage, assistant; not each checked).

history.note: Raised in DG6 round 3 by domain-reviewer. Medium: a real error-state defect in the new D-209 flow, with a bounded effect (administrator forms only). Suggested repair: map /config/credentialRefs/<key> (and the equivalent pointers of the webhook, SMTP, storage and assistant forms) to the credential row. Add en/ar texts for validation.secret_ref_not_bound, validation.secret_ref_host_not_bound and validation.secret_ref_namespace. Add a component test and an e2e step.
